player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: No valid move format found. Use '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Muthu {player_id}, Kitendo kisicho sahihi. Safu {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambari ya kibwanya {pile_index} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.non_positive: Cjk, esengeli ku tlosa kintu ca 1
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Hauwezi kubwanya {quantity} kutoka kibwanya {pile_index} (kuna {pile_count} tu zimesalia).

observation.removed_from_piles: Muthu {player_id} alisonga [{pile_index} {quantity}], akibwanya {quantity} kibwanya (s) kutoka kibwanya {pile_index}.
